The '''Nar Shaddaa Labor Alliance''' was a organization of [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] that existed in the years of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The rise of these slavers rose after the rapid expansion of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], whose exhaustive need for labor led to an increased demand in the number of potential buyers. Thus, whilst slavery was banned in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], this profitable imperial market led to numerous organizations such as the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] along with the Nar Shaddaa Labor Alliance transforming [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] into the galaxy's premier location for slavers to display and sell their products.

In this era, [[Maro Vizhen]] of the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] attempted to cultivate allies for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on Nar Shaddaa amongst the criminal underworld. These allies consisted of: the Labor Alliance, [[Godoba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who owned the [[Club Vertica Casino]], and the [[DX annihilator network]] who formed the [[Shadow Syndicate/Legends|Shadow Syndicate]]. However, these efforts were opposed by [[Ukabi]] who was in charge of the local [[Exchange]] forces. During this period, [[Vaarko Tiyai]] served as [[Cho'mash]] of the Alliance.<ref name="SW TOR" />
